Container.Name: Tapeory
Container.Overview:
Design, store, and print Brother P-touch labels from your browser. Tapeory is a self-hosted web app for label templates: design a label in the browser editor, add named fields like "Name" or "Room", and fill them in when you print. You can also import existing P-touch Editor .lbx files.
Requires a MySQL 8 or MariaDB database, for example Unraid's "mariadb" template. Create an empty database and a user, then enter the connection in the web UI on first start.
Printing supports 34 Brother P-touch (PT) and QL label printers, from the PT-P750W and PT-P900 series to the QL-500 through QL-1115NWB. After the database setup you create the first account, the administrator; more accounts can be added as administrators or users.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: label labels brother ptouch p-touch lbx printer tape
Container.Requires: A MySQL 8 or MariaDB database, e.g. the "mariadb" container from Community Applications.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the Tapeory web UI and API are served on.

Config.Name: Storage Path
Config.Description: Templates, uploads, rendered labels, backups, and the saved database connection. Back this up regularly.

Config.Name: Database Connection String
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to enter the database connection in the web UI on first start (it's saved to the storage path). If set, e.g. server=192.168.1.10;port=3306;database=tapeory;user=tapeory;password=CHANGE_ME; it overrides that and the setup screen is skipped.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the storage path; the app runs as this user. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the storage path. Unraid default: 100 (users).

Config.Name: Auto Migrate Database
Config.Description: Automatically apply pending database migrations on container start.
